paper_metadata.title: Effect of Ni Addition on the Glass Forming Ability and Mechanical Properties in Cu60Zr22Ti18 Metallic Glass Alloy

evidence.quote: This paper investigates the effects of Ni addition on the glass forming ability (GFA) and mechanical properties in Cu60C0xNixZr22Ti18 (x ¼ 0C24 15) metallic glass alloys.

mechanisms.name: atomic size mismatch and atomic packing density increase

evidence.quote: A large atomic size difference between Ni and other constituent elements is favorable to increasing an atomic packing density of the liquid structure, leading to an increase in viscosity in the supercooled liquid region.
it is assumed that the Ni plays a similar role to increase the Tx of Cu-Ni-Zr-Ti alloys.

mechanisms.name: multiple shear band formation by nanocrystallization

evidence.quote: the metallic glasses with low activation energy for crystallization tend to form nanocrystals during deformation, which would act as initiation sites to form multiple shear bands, leading to enhanced plasticity.
